title: `cloud_search_fwd` fills C with the N loop score
body:
At the end of `cloud_search_fwd` in `libnail/src/align/cloud_search.rs`, the loop that fills C reads the N loop score:

```rust
mx[(C, seq_idx)] = log_sum!(
    mx[(C, seq_idx - 1)] + prf[BackgroundLoop(N)],
    mx[(E, seq_idx)] + prf.special_transitions[Profile::E_IDX][Profile::SPECIAL_MOVE_IDX]
);
```

The C recurrence would read `BackgroundLoop(C)`. `cloud_search_bwd` uses `BackgroundLoop(C)` where it precomputes C.

Today the result is the same either way. `Profile::configure_for_target_length` sets the N, J and C loop scores to one value, and on the fixture seed `7tm_1` against `O08858|reviewed|Somatostatin` both read -0.0055. The difference would show only if the loop scores were ever set apart.

Found while reading the cloud search for a figure. Nothing was changed.
